notes:
T-032 (issue https://github.com/UBayouski/tracenotes/issues/29, ticket tickets/T-032-release-notes-audit-skill.md) adds the Claude Code project skill .claude/skills/release-notes-audit/ in the Agent Skills format: SKILL.md (procedure) and scripts/audit.ts, a factory script whose pure auditNotes() compares saved outputs of `git rev-list`, `tracenotes group`, `render --format json`, `render` (Markdown) and `check` for one range, with five checks (exactly-once, counts, json-links, markdown-links, check-agrees).

Design facts checked in the code: groupCommits() places every commit in exactly one of ignored, Breaking changes, a type section or Unclassified (src/group.ts:111-127), so exactly-once is checked on group's output; render keeps group's order and lists only shown entries with source.sha and commitUrl = repoUrl + /commit/ + sha (src/render.ts:85-125); Markdown has one `- ` line per entry with `[short](repo/commit/sha)` and an optional PR link, and escapeText escapes brackets in subjects (src/render.ts:17-24, 142-170). The script follows the scripts convention in AGENTS.md: functions return values, only the entry block touches the process. Tests build inputs with the real CLI main() and injected IO; no test runs git (rule 5). tsconfig.json and the source-hygiene walk include .claude/skills.

Checks run: npm run check passes (typecheck + 335 tests, Windows). The SKILL.md blocks were dry-run one shell call each (steps 2-5 on d8199fe..3903f33: PASS); the whole history at 3903f33 (76 commits) also PASS with the earlier version. Not run: Linux (CI will).

Out of scope in the working tree: journal/day-12.md has an unrelated uncommitted edit by the human; it is not part of this change.

Agent: the audit reports and stops on FAIL; it never fixes code or outputs. check exiting 1 is the check's verdict on the history, not an audit failure.
